name: cmplx
description: Cyclomatic complexity diagnostics and hover for JavaScript, TypeScript and Rust

cmplx.threshold.markdownDescription: Functions scoring at or above this value are warnings; at or above twice it, errors. Leave `null` to use the `threshold` in `cmplx.toml`, or the built-in default if there is no such file.

cmplx.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `cmplx` executable. Leave blank to resolve from `PATH`, falling back to `~/.cargo/bin/cmplx`.
